runs.scope: Behavioral smoke only; no full-root overhead or isolated provider attribution.

cpu.scope: process.cpuUsage: every thread in this process, including worker threads; child processes have separate rusage and are excluded; not exclusive to this span and overlapping for nested spans

thread.scope: process.threadCpuUsage: the collector thread only; excludes worker threads and runtime helper threads

otherThreads.scope: arithmetic difference of the process-wide delta and this-thread delta; covers worker threads and runtime helper threads; a measurement gap, never an attribution to them

heapStatistics.reason: V8 heap-statistics field semantics are not verified for this Bun runtime; use the separately labelled process boundary samples

allocationVolume.reason: no verified cumulative allocation counter is exposed by this collector; Bun total_allocated_bytes is heap capacity, not allocation volume

footprintBytes.reason: no runtime API exposes the OS memory footprint (for example macOS phys_footprint); RSS and peak RSS are different resident-size measurements

liveHeapBytes.reason: liveness and retaining ownership are not measured; heap boundary sizes do not identify them, and the collector never forces GC or captures a retaining graph

allocationRequests.reason: no allocation-site hook is installed; inspector heap sampling is a statistical sample of allocated and collected objects, not an allocation-request count

workerThreads.reason: a producer-created worker thread registers no identity with this collector; a profile created inside that worker carries its own pid/threadId, and process.cpuUsage includes both threads while threadCpuUsage covers only the creating thread

childProcesses.reason: no portable child-process enumeration is available; child CPU/RSS is recorded only from an explicit producer receipt (wait4/rusage/NATIVE_PHASE) and is never merged into span CPU or this process's CPU
